<issue>
RSA signature verification fails with bytes keys

#### Description

When using RSA keys as bytes objects for OAuth1 signature verification, the signature process produces incorrect results. The key handling appears to be corrupted during processing.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from oauthlib.oauth1.rfc5849.signature import sign_rsa_sha1_with_client, verify_rsa_sha1
from oauthlib.oauth1.rfc5849.endpoints.base import MockClient, MockRequest

# RSA private key as bytes
rsa_private_key_bytes = b"""-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
MIICXgIBAAKBgQDk1/bxyS8Q8jiheHeYYp/4rEKJopeQRRKKpZI4s5i+UPwVpupG
AlwXWfzXwSMaKPAoKJNdu7tqKRniqst5uoHXw98gj0M9SztOTCe/4Cz1GGQZ7Qr
...
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----"""

# RSA public key as bytes  
rsa_public_key_bytes = b"""-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----
MIGfMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBAQUAA4GNADCBiQKBgQDk1/bxyS8Q8jiheHeYYp/4rEKJ
...
-----END PUBLIC KEY-----"""

signature_base_string = "POST&http%3A//example.com/request&oauth_consumer_key%3Dkey%26oauth_nonce%3D37026175%26oauth_signature_method%3DRSA-SHA1%26oauth_timestamp%3D1318467427%26oauth_version%3D1.0"

# Create clients with bytes keys
private_client = MockClient(rsa_key=rsa_private_key_bytes)
public_client = MockClient(rsa_key=rsa_public_key_bytes)

# This should work but produces wrong signature
signature = sign_rsa_sha1_with_client(signature_base_string, private_client)
print(f"Generated signature: {signature}")

# Verification fails
params = [('oauth_consumer_key', 'key'), ('oauth_nonce', '37026175'), ('oauth_signature_method', 'RSA-SHA1'), ('oauth_timestamp', '1318467427'), ('oauth_version', '1.0')]
request = MockRequest('POST', 'http://example.com/request', params, signature)
result = verify_rsa_sha1(request, public_client.rsa_key)
print(f"Verification result: {result}")  # Should be True but returns False
```

The same code works correctly when the RSA keys are provided as strings instead of bytes.
</issue>
